title: Multiattribute Search: Empirical Evidence and Information Design
eligible_reason: Structural model of gradual multiattribute consumer search (car clickstream) estimated in C++ with counterfactual information-design scenarios. No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: main.cpp/estimation.cpp estimate the search model on clickstream.txt with simulated beliefs (simul_for_c.txt); action_corresp.txt selects counterfactual scenarios.
data_files_note: Clickstream and characteristic files shipped; README does not state whether they are original or altered.
data_provenance_note: No statement of simulation or disguise in README.txt; not verified.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
